props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible alt text — also used to derive initials when `text` is absent.

props.name: chip
props.description:
Decorative chip rendered on top of the avatar. Pass `true` for the
default style, or a `ChipProps` object to customize color / size /
position / inset. Defaults to `inset: true` so it isn't clipped by the
avatar's `overflow-hidden` root.

props.name: icon
props.description: Iconify name shown when neither `src` nor `text` resolve to content.

props.name: src
props.description: Image source URL. Renders an `<image>`; on load failure it falls back to initials/icon.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Replaces the entire avatar inner content.

slots.name: fallback
slots.description: Replaces just the initials/icon fallback (no image).
